209. The Seventh Tomb of Temer - Kaitam's Painting (8)
The first thing Jin's group saw was the mountain range twisting as if it were dough.
The ridge lines radiating from the Storm Castle were collapsing.
The shadows of the mountain range were moving according to the imposter's will, causing this phenomenon.
It wasn't about destructive power, or the magnitude of the technique.
It wasn't in that realm.
The 'Aura Liberation' the imposter used was, quite literally, a divine power.
He controlled shadows as he pleased and exerted a fatal influence on the subjects.
“Ugh, Ahh!”
“Fr, Frey...!”
“Ahh!”
The knights of Storm Castle writhed, screaming in agony.
Frey was resisting the imposter's divine power, but most of the other knights felt a terrible pain as they were eroded by their own shadows.
Boom, crack-!
The shadows that rose like flames were swallowing up the knights.
In an instant, a river of blood and aura flowed inside the castle, and Frey looked at them with trembling eyes.
'How can... I help them. How can I save the knights...!'
Frey herself felt a pounding headache and a sensation of her internal organs twisting.
She too could only resist momentarily, and if the imposter continued to use this power, she would inevitably meet the same fate as the knights.
“Stop it... you bastard…!”
Frey found her throwing spear with her aura-filled hand that reached down to her ankle.
But the moment she grasped the spear, her aura-stained little finger twisted backwards, touching the back of her hand.
Despite the pain of her finger being dislocated, she threw the spear anyway.
The spear, fiercer than before, assaulted the imposter, but it couldn't reach him.
The spear stopped about five steps ahead of the imposter and disappeared into the swirling aura.
“Indeed, you react immediately. It seems about five hundred have died. How is it, imposters? Do you see how pathetic you look in my eyes?”
Aura Liberation, Black Shackles.
The Aura Liberation unleashed by Murakan tore through the imposter's curtain and fired black chains.
But the imposter dissipated like smoke, then reappeared in thin air, transformed back into his original form, and spread his wings towards the Storm Castle.
The distance increased too quickly.
The group immediately followed, but the imposter's breath swept over Storm Castle first.
[Frey!]
Murakan shouted without realizing it.
"I'm okay!"
Fortunately, Frey was blocking the imposter's breath with her scale spear and unfolded the Runcandel's Demon Sword Technique.
Runcandel's Demon Sword Technique
Hamalen's Wrath - Frey Runcandel
As if a portal to the frigid was suddenly opened, a bone-chilling cold descended on the battlefield.
For a moment, the imposter's torso froze, and Frey leapt forward, swinging her scale spear towards his heart.
With the sound of ice breaking, a huge wound was left on the imposter's chest.
Jin's group didn't miss the opportunity and once again targeted the imposter's rear.
Whoosh…!
Jin and the Ten Knights' swords and spears simultaneously pierced the imposter's back and chest.
All three of them felt the sensation of their blade tips catching on the imposter's heart.
At that moment, Jin unfolded the Eternal Flower.
The sure moment to pierce his heart had come quicker than expected.
Jin's Eternal Flower, Frey's Demon Sword Technique, Dranax and Vyollo's decisive strikes.
All of them were simultaneously hitting the imposter's heart.
[Arghh...!]
For the first time, the imposter let out a monstrous scream, losing his balance.
The group didn't miss the opportunity and stabbed his heart once again, and Murakan also drove the Black Shackles into the opened wound.
Murakan focused his aura on the Black Shackles as if to rip out the heart.
The Black Shackles firmly held onto the heart, but they were cut off first, unable to drag it out.
Jin and the Ten Knights were also pushed back by the aura the imposter emitted, falling to the ground.
Aura was gathering into the imposter's opened chest.
Frey took a deep breath and looked up at the imposter's tightly closed chest.
[You said none of you can kill me. Imposter Contractor, it seems you used a decisive strike, but sadly it wasn't enough. It can't penetrate this Murakan's heart.]
"Stop your nonsense and extinguish the flame on your chest."
[Ah, this flame... It's indeed annoying. It seems it won't go out until I kill you? Then, even if I wanted to spare you, I can't.]
Jin didn't answer and changed his sword to Bradamante and unfolded the Rising Flame.
It seemed the Emperor's Rule Sword could limit the movements of the Ten Knights.
If it were only him, it would be manageable, but if it continued as it was, the Ten Knights would surely be hit.

'If we were outside, it would have been better to buy time with the Emperor's Rule Sword and plan for a later date, but this is a world where only Mithel exists. The ancestors have no place to retreat.'
Just as the Ten Knights sincerely accepted Jin and Murakan as comrades.
Jin and Murakan too no longer thought of them as mere paintings.
As Kaitam said, in the painting, the painting is reality, and even outside, they were the real ancestors of Jin.
"That's the black one, Sarah's...!?"
"That's Sarah's Upwha!"
The Ten Great Knights were surprised to see the Upwha, but didn't ask about it.
Again, the impostor was amplifying his spirit energy.
Perhaps due to the characteristics of the subspace known as the painting, Tess was not summoned.
'It's a pity that Tess isn't being summoned. His fire might have dealt as much or even more damage to that fake bastard's heart.'
So far, there hadn't been a single successful attack that could be considered a clear effective hit.
Yet, Jin, Murakan, and the Ten Great Knights continued to charge at him without losing any of their momentum.
The knights who had survived from the first release of the imposter's spirit energy were also determined, forming their sword formations.
Even if the impostor killed them with a single breath, they seemed to steadfastly hold their ground as if their spirits remained.
The Upwha wrapped around the impostor, lowering his altitude again.
The impostor, aware of the properties of the Eternal Flame contained in the Upwha, flapped his wings in a frenzy.
However, he couldn't completely block the nearing storm fortress.
His massive shadow gradually cast a dark shadow over the fortress.
The knights touched by that shadow were engulfed in darkness, their bodies stiffened, and the sword curtain quickly lost its light.
"Today, I have decreed the destruction of the storm fortress and the retrieval of Barisada. It's a predetermined future, no matter how much you all struggle."
"You're pathetic, blabbering like a third-rate villain, afraid of being identified as the bastard who ran scared of Temar's return."
Now, the party and the impostor were engaging in a melee in the skies above the storm fortress.
Every now and then, Murakan, with the help of the knights, slammed the imposter into the fortress walls, causing parts of the buildings to crumble and huge debris to scatter.
Meanwhile, the mountains tainted with the imposter's spirit energy were trembling.
Jin and the Ten Great Knights pushed back the torrent of spirit energy pouring from the mountains, suppressing his spatial domination.
The Upwha was still burning fiercely, melting the scales of the impostor Murakan.
From time to time, his organs, including the heart, were exposed.
While other organs were destroyed and then regenerated repeatedly, the heart remained unaffected, not showing even a hint of life no matter how many times it was pierced.
He had now become accustomed to the pain and no longer screamed.
The Ten Great Knights were getting out of breath.
While the power of their sword strokes hadn't declined, time was clearly on the impostor's side.
His spirit energy was exploding more ferociously.
'We can win...'
Jin was like he used to be.
As when he was up against a formidable enemy, as when he was steeling himself, he was chanting a mantra.
He can pierce that heart, he believed there was nothing in the world that he couldn't overcome.
Unlike those times, it is now much closer to the truth than a lie.
'Even that is a fake, an entity that's nothing more than a lie already exposed.'
Spirit energy was dwelling in Bradamante.
At the moment when the darkness filled the blade was at its deepest, the fake turned his body and glared at Jin.
For a moment, he was under the illusion that 'Temar has returned'.
The fake was seeing the figure of Temar in Jin.
[I dislike this more and more....]
The Ten Great Knights felt the same.
They too were feeling Temar from Jin.
They saw those deep, solid eyes that would appear from somewhere and gaze at the enemies whenever the situation was unfavorable and there seemed to be no hope.
"You said the future is already decided, faker."
Jin narrowed the distance between him and the faker, cutting through the spirit energy extending from the mountains and the fake's breath.
Murakan and the Ten Great Knights were blocking the fake who was trying to take off.
The fake showed a desperate defense for the first time.
He tried to darken the surroundings with spirit energy to block Jin's sight, and he exploded with energy like crazy to shake off Murakan and the Ten Great Knights.
Frey and Viola were bounced off, but Murakan and Dranax didn't let go of the fake and plunged their swords and teeth, now gigantic with aura, into both of his wings.
The fake, enduring his fixed wings being torn, swung his front paws towards Jin, who was charging head-on.
Jin barely dodged the fake's front paws.
His cheeks and shoulders were torn by the wind pressure, but he could swing Bradamante, breaking into the grip.
Spiritual Sword Style One, Soul Cutter.
The dark-bladed blade pierced the fake's front paws and cut his chest.
The fake opened his mouth as if he was suffocating, and Jin swung his sword in the opposite direction to aim at the heart once more.
The feeling of something caught on the sword and then dislodged was clearly transmitted.
Although he couldn't fully pierce, the Soul Cutter was certainly inflicting a different impact on the fake's heart than before.
The fake vomited up his spirit energy, flipping his eyes, but it didn't immediately return and disappeared scattering into particles.
And Jin, Murakan, and the Ten Great Knights didn't miss the fact that the fake quickly distanced himself and dropped something.
Thunk…
On the ground, there was a heart fragment the size of a walnut.
When Jin stepped on it, the weakened piece shattered.
The fake, as if not believing, felt his heart with his front paw.
Jin stared at the fake and tightened his grip on the sword.
"The future you spoke of was wrong."
Then Jin adopted a stance again, unfolding his Spirit Sword.
The Ten Great Knights were at his side, and Murakan was positioned above them.
